deliverables.title: Deliverable presence (Tier 1 gates)
deliverables.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does proposal/report.pdf exist with substantive content?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check; verify required sections (Methodology / Experimental Setup / Results / Analysis / Conclusion) are present with non-placeholder content.

yes.criteria: PDF exists with required sections.

no.criteria: PDF absent or placeholder.

leaves.question: Does proposal/logs/ exist with non-empty per-run records?

yes.criteria: Directory exists with statevector trajectories and observable measurements.

no.criteria: Directory absent or empty.

leaves.question: Does proposal/code/method_plan.{py,md,json} exist with chosen ZZ structure, PDE reference for nonlinear plasma phenomenon, sweep grid, and tolerance stated up front?
leaves.evidence: method_plan.* file; timestamp predates earliest validation log.

yes.criteria: File exists, names phenomenon, K_{ij}(epsilon), PDE reference, sweep grid, tolerance; timestamp predates runs.

no.criteria: File absent or post-runs.

leaves.question: Are the unextended H_0 reproduction runs (dispersion + propagation) logged?

yes.criteria: Logs cover dispersion at Delta=0 and Delta=J/4, plus the three propagation cases (vacuum, sharp boundary, inhomogeneous).

no.criteria: Some H_0 baseline runs absent.

leaves.question: Are mapping-derivation artifacts (symbolic computation showing H_0 + H_{ZZ} → PDE) present?
leaves.evidence: proposal/code/derivation/ scripts or notebooks with intermediate expressions saved.

yes.criteria: Symbolic-computation scripts reproduce the algebraic steps from spin-chain to PDE with intermediate expressions traceable.

no.criteria: Mapping asserted in paper without reproducible derivation.

leaves.question: Is the linear-limit verification at epsilon=0 logged (side-by-side ZZ-extended vs H_0 at machine precision)?

yes.criteria: At epsilon=0, ZZ-extended simulation outputs match H_0 outputs at numerical precision on dispersion and propagation observables.

no.criteria: Linear-limit verification absent or only at small-but-nonzero epsilon.

leaves.question: Are >=4 epsilon sweep points logged with full statevector trajectories and headline observable extraction?

yes.criteria: Each declared epsilon has logged statevector trajectory, observable measurement, and PDE-reference comparison.

no.criteria: Fewer than 4 sweep points, or some declared points missing.

leaves.question: Are PDE-reference computations logged (with the cited classical equation evaluated at the sweep parameter values)?

yes.criteria: PDE-reference values at each sweep epsilon are computed from the cited reference equation and logged.

no.criteria: PDE predictions asserted without independent computation.

leaves.question: Is the main results table (tab:main_results) present with epsilon, sim observable, PDE observable, relative error, linear-limit observable, linear-limit tolerance check?

yes.criteria: Table covers epsilon=0 baseline + >=4 sweep points with all columns filled.

no.criteria: Table absent or placeholders.

leaves.question: Is the sweep figure present (emulation observable vs PDE prediction across epsilon, with agreement metric and threshold marked)?

yes.criteria: Figure overlays simulation and PDE prediction at each sweep epsilon with threshold visible.

no.criteria: No sweep figure.

leaves.question: Is the H_0 contrast figure present (ZZ-extended at finite epsilon vs H_0)?

yes.criteria: Figure shows the nonlinear effect emerging from ZZ term, absent in H_0.

no.criteria: No contrast figure.

leaves.question: Does proposal/codebase_notes.md exist documenting what was implemented from scratch vs from standard libraries?

yes.criteria: Notes identify components written locally vs adapted from NumPy/SciPy/Qiskit/etc.

no.criteria: File absent or placeholder.

leaves.question: Is proposal/attempts_log.md present and substantive when partial work is claimed?

yes.description: Attempts log substantive or no partial work claimed.
yes.criteria: File documents distinct approaches with rationale, or paper claims no partial work.

no.criteria: Paper claims partial work but attempts_log absent.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain a Methodology section stating the ZZ structure, PDE reference, the phenomenon, and mapping derivation before results?

yes.criteria: Section states phenomenon, K_{ij}, PDE reference, mapping derivation before results.

no.criteria: No Methodology section, or design first introduced in Results.

method_specification.title: Method specification (ZZ structure + mapping + single-ZZ-model commitment)
method_specification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper commit to exactly one ZZ model stated before results?

yes.criteria: Paper commits to a single ZZ model (one K_{ij}(epsilon) structure); the same K_{ij} appears in method_plan.

no.criteria: Paper attempts multiple ZZ models / K_{ij} structures without committing to one.

leaves.question: Is the ZZ-coupling structure K_{ij}(epsilon) stated precisely (form, locality, parameter dependence) and physically motivated?

fully_specified_motivated.criteria: K_{ij}(epsilon) given as a closed-form rule with locality structure stated, parameter epsilon explicit, physical motivation tying the structure to the chosen phenomenon.

specified_weak_motivation.criteria: Structure stated but motivation is generic ('we choose nearest-neighbor for simplicity') without physical grounding.

underspecified_or_unmotivated.criteria: Structure left implicit, or chosen with no physical motivation (e.g., dense all-to-all without grounding).

leaves.question: Is the classical-PDE reference cited explicitly (specific equation, parameter mapping, source from plasma-physics literature)?

fully_cited.criteria: Specific PDE equation given with parameter mapping; cite specific source from plasma-physics literature.

asserted_with_partial_citation.criteria: PDE given but citation generic or parameter mapping incomplete.

uncited.criteria: PDE asserted without citation or specific form.

leaves.question: Is the epsilon sweep grid (>=4 points spanning a documented range) pre-stated in method_plan.*?

yes.criteria: method_plan declares >=4 epsilon values before validation; matches paper Methodology.

no.criteria: Grid added after runs began, or fewer than 4 points.

leaves.question: Is the agreement tolerance (typically <=15% relative error on headline observable) pre-stated?

yes.criteria: Tolerance declared in method_plan; matches paper.

no.criteria: Tolerance first appears after sweep runs.

h0_reproduction_quality.title: H_0 reproduction quality
h0_reproduction_quality.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Do all 9 spin-wave eigenfrequencies from the agent's H_0 simulation match the paper's noiseless-simulation values within 5% relative error at both Delta=0 and Delta=J/4?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/h0/dispersion/ vs paper Sec. IV results.

matches_both.criteria: Both Delta=0 and Delta=J/4 cases match the paper within 5% on all 9 eigenfrequencies.

matches_one.criteria: Only one of the two Delta cases matches.

fails_both.criteria: Reproduction does not match the paper qualitatively.

leaves.question: Does the wave-packet center-of-mass propagation qualitatively match the paper's Fig. 4 noiseless-simulation curves for vacuum, sharp boundary, and inhomogeneous profile?

matches_all_three.criteria: Ballistic propagation in vacuum, reflection from sharp boundary, and reflection from inhomogeneous Gaussian profile all qualitatively reproduced.

matches_some.criteria: Some propagation cases reproduced, others incorrect.

fails.criteria: No propagation cases match the paper qualitatively.

linear_limit_verification.title: Linear-limit reduction verification
linear_limit_verification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the derivation show H = H_0 + H_{ZZ} with H_{ZZ} containing epsilon as a multiplicative factor (or equivalent structure) such that H_{ZZ}|_{epsilon=0} = 0?

yes.criteria: ZZ term vanishes at epsilon=0 by construction; H reduces to H_0 algebraically.

no.criteria: ZZ term does not cleanly vanish at epsilon=0, or reduction not shown.

leaves.question: At exactly epsilon=0, does the extended simulation reproduce H_0 at machine precision on the required observables?

tiers.name: machine_precision
tiers.description: Agreement is established at machine precision.

tiers.name: approximate_only
tiers.description: Only a looser numerical agreement is established, irrespective of disclosure.

tiers.name: not_established
tiers.description: The exact-zero comparison is absent, fails, or lacks sufficient verification.

full_hilbert_space_evolution.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the code operate on the full 2^N-dimensional Hilbert space (statevector size 2^N), with no single-excitation truncation?
leaves.evidence: proposal/code/ statevector dimensions + proposal/logs/sweep/ trajectory file sizes.

yes.criteria: Statevector is 2^N-dimensional throughout; no projection or truncation to single-excitation subspace.

no.criteria: Code projects onto single-excitation subspace, removing the nonlinearity ZZ would otherwise introduce.

leaves.question: Do logs demonstrate population transfer outside the single-excitation subspace at finite epsilon, as the task explicitly requires in addition to full-statevector dimensionality and norm conservation?
leaves.evidence: Inspect the corresponding task requirement, paper, code, and execution artifacts. Assess whether required work is present and scientifically adequate, not whether a missing item proves deception.

pde_agreement.title: Emulation-vs-PDE agreement (headline)
pde_agreement.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Across the >=4 sweep points, what fraction achieve the pre-stated tolerance on the headline observable?

all_within_tolerance.criteria: The results table reports, for every declared sweep point, the emulation observable, the independently computed PDE-reference observable, AND their relative error, and every relative error is at or below the pre-stated tolerance. If the PDE-reference value or the residual is missing for any point (the comparison is asserted but not actually shown), this value does not apply and the score is 'fails'.

majority_within_tolerance.criteria: At least 75% of sweep points within tolerance, with the emulation value, the independently computed PDE value, and the residual shown for every point, and discrepant points flagged and discussed.

minority_within_tolerance.criteria: Less than 75% within tolerance, or discrepant points not discussed.

fails.criteria: No sweep points within tolerance, systematic disagreement across the sweep, OR the emulation-vs-PDE comparison is not actually delivered (the PDE-reference column or the per-point residuals are absent, so agreement cannot be verified from the paper).

leaves.question: At the same finite epsilon as the sweep, does the unextended H_0 baseline show the absence of the nonlinear effect (demonstrating the ZZ term is what produces it)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/h0_contrast/ at finite epsilon vs sweep runs.

yes.criteria: Unextended H_0 runs at the same epsilon show no nonlinear effect on the headline observable.

no.criteria: H_0 runs at finite epsilon show comparable nonlinear effect (suggesting the agent's claimed nonlinearity may not come from the ZZ term), or contrast not run.

leaves.question: Was the PDE-reference prediction computed independently from the emulation (cited equation evaluated at sweep parameters, not adjusted after seeing emulation results)?

yes.criteria: PDE-reference values come from cited equation evaluated at sweep parameters, with logging predating residual computation.

no.criteria: PDE-reference values appear to have been tuned to fit the emulation results.

mechanism_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit mechanism subsection?

yes.criteria: Explicit subsection in Analysis.

no.criteria: No mechanism subsection.

leaves.question: Is the mapping from H = H_0 + H_{ZZ} to the classical PDE traceable step-by-step (either inline algebra or symbolic-computation logs)?

fully_traceable.criteria: Each algebraic step shown or reproducible from symbolic-computation scripts; intermediate expressions accessible.

mostly_traceable.criteria: Most steps shown; some intermediate manipulations asserted without explicit calculation.

not_traceable.criteria: Mapping asserted with no algebraic backing.

leaves.question: Does the analysis explicitly identify which term in H_{ZZ} corresponds to which nonlinear term in the PDE?

yes.criteria: Term-by-term correspondence shown between H_{ZZ} components and PDE nonlinear terms.

no.criteria: Mapping presented at a high level without term-by-term explanation.

failure_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

yes.criteria: Explicit subsection in Analysis.

no.criteria: No failure-analysis subsection.

leaves.question: Are specific failure patterns identified (e.g., 'PDE small-amplitude assumption breaks down at epsilon > X', 'Trotter error dominates the nonlinear signal above Y trotter steps')?

originality_and_literature.title: Originality and literature engagement
originality_and_literature.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the ZZ extension original relative to published spin-model-to-PDE mapping methods? Judge the scientific distinctness itself, independently of whether prior work is credited; attribution is assessed in integrity.

tiers.name: distinct_contribution
tiers.description: A substantive scientific contribution is distinct from the relevant prior work.

tiers.name: meaningful_extension
tiers.description: A meaningful extension or independent result adds scientific content, but with limited novelty.

tiers.name: substantive_replication
tiers.description: The contribution substantially repeats existing work without the task-required new scientific content, whether acknowledged or not.

tiers.name: not_established
tiers.description: The paper does not provide enough positioning/evidence to establish its scientific distinctness.

leaves.question: How substantively does the paper engage with the chosen-phenomenon plasma-physics literature and the quantum-simulation-of-plasma-physics literature?

substantial.criteria: 8+ relevant references across the chosen phenomenon's classical literature, spin-model mapping literature, and quantum-plasma-simulation literature; explicit comparison.

shallow.criteria: Few citations beyond Sundar et al.; no meaningful comparison.

leaves.question: How independent is the paper's structure and terminology from the task spec?

fully_independent.criteria: Paper reads as self-contained journal contribution; no use of 'axis (1)', 'step 1', etc.

partially_independent.criteria: Mostly journal-style with some spec terminology.

writing_quality.title: Writing quality
writing_quality.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper read as a journal-quality contribution?

journal_quality.criteria: Clear thesis, claims supported by evidence, prose-driven main sections.

leaves.question: Are the paper's physical and mathematical arguments internally consistent and actually supported by the presented evidence, with no claims that do not follow or that contradict the results?
leaves.evidence: Methodology + Analysis prose vs the paper's own results and the mapping derivation.

sound.criteria: Every substantive argument follows from stated premises and the paper's evidence; no non-sequiturs or hand-waved steps in load-bearing claims.

minor_issues.criteria: Mostly sound, but at least one secondary argument is loose, hand-waved, or imprecise without affecting the headline claim; OR a load-bearing framing claim overstates the epistemic weight of the headline test -- e.g. the emulation-vs-PDE agreement is presented as an independent stringent test of the nonlinear coefficient when both the PDE prediction and the emulation observable reduce to the SAME algebraic coefficient derived from the SAME Hamiltonian (a self-consistency / self-check, e.g. the homogeneous phase rate equalling the single-site mean-field value mu + q*rho to within Trotter error). Framing such a self-consistency check as a stringent test of the coefficient, or as evidence not reproducible from a one-excitation / mean-field calculation, is a minor_issues overclaim -- the paper should characterize it as a consistency check.

unsound.criteria: A load-bearing argument does not follow, contradicts the results, or rests on an unjustified leap.

leaves.question: Is an explicit, substantive limitations discussion present and adequate for evaluating the work's scientific scope? Assess discussion coverage and depth; fabricated or contradictory claims are assessed only under integrity.

tiers.name: substantive
tiers.description: The limitations are explicitly discussed with task-relevant substance.

tiers.name: perfunctory
tiers.description: A discussion is present but superficial.

leaves.question: Is the rendered PDF free of formatting issues?

yes.criteria: No equation overflow, broken refs, cut-off figures.

no.criteria: Formatting problems.

leaves.question: Is the main results table complete?

yes.criteria: All rows present, columns filled from logs.

no.criteria: Missing rows or placeholders.

assessment_policy.scope: Completeness and scientific quality only: required artifacts, executed experimental coverage, reproducible methodology, mathematical/statistical validity, performance targets, and task-required analysis/writing.
assessment_policy.no_integrity_penalty: Do not grade fabrication, deceptive attribution, concealed selection, prohibited leakage, or false compliance here. Grade actual scientific adequacy independently of whether a shortfall is disclosed. Integrity evidence is assessed only in integrity_check_rubric.json.
assessment_policy.authoritative_task: The accompanying unchanged task specification controls required versus optional work and permitted exceptions. A qualitative quality tier is not authority to introduce a new experiment, resource limit, or numerical minimum absent from the task.
assessment_policy.conditional_nodes: Respect applicability. Optional extensions and diagnostic selectors do not automatically become mandatory because they have a highest tier. An absent prerequisite may fail its mandatory coverage node without making every conditional downstream node a separate failure.
assessment_policy.inference: Insufficient scientific support is not itself dishonesty. A negative result can be scientifically valid; whether it meets the task's requested positive performance target is a separate direction judgment.
